status_rows.title: Public feedback portal
status_rows.gap: Gap: owner-configured workspace identity and a changed portal description have no passing assertion.

status_rows.title: Public product landing
status_rows.gap: The run site's built landing page at both widths with no cross-origin request, cookie or workspace read; no test reads the built site yet.

status_rows.title: Public documentation
status_rows.gap: Gap: manifest navigation order; build/development rendering and rejection of unlisted Markdown, broken links and forbidden image paths; full header/footer and page-navigation semantics; client navigation and HTML escaping; nested-unknown-slug 404/article exclusion; and workspace/session/cookie isolation lack sentence-complete running assertions.

status_rows.title: Roles
status_rows.gap: Current operators share product access, and workspace clock settings admit Owners and Admins (OPS-008) while other configuration remains owner-only. No journey yet signs in one operator per role: the Viewer, Contributor, Product manager and Admin refusals, unchanged state on refusal and next-request role change lack passing assertions.

status_rows.title: First-run setup
status_rows.gap: A signed-in operator who is not the owner never being sent to `/setup`, setup completion staying out of archives, an installation with an active owner being treated as finished, and local `rer dev` opening signed in as the owner with mail suppressed have no passing assertion.

status_rows.title: Global search
status_rows.gap: Search across every other named field ships; product, component and feature names are not yet searched (`src/core/features/workspace/list-repository.ts`), and the 500 ms first page has no seeded run at the `seed.json` limits (D-3).

status_rows.title: Duplicate suggestions
status_rows.evidence: `tests/base/penny-evidence.test.ts` — "[EVID-007][REQ-004] deterministic published-only suggestions rank lexical overlap within 500ms without linking, merging or creating drafts" proves published-only results, lexical determinism without a model, unchanged link and merge graphs, and explicit vote and follow actions; `tests/runtime/duplicate-suggestions-scale.mjs` measures public and operator p95 for exact, partial, absent and Unicode queries at the declared request, board and requester limits (D-3).

status_rows.title: Tags
status_rows.gap: Tags filtering every operator list, surviving a request merge and appearing in the export have no passing assertion; tag privacy is asserted.

status_rows.title: Requester identity
status_rows.gap: The requester's chosen display name in a portal response has no passing assertion, and the check that no email address or account appears reads the public request list while it holds no published request, so it checks an empty list; submissions under a valid host-signed identity, with and without outbound mail, and the refusal of invalid or new host identities without mail are asserted.

status_rows.title: Submission
status_rows.gap: The unreviewed evidence item created in the same transaction as the request, and requester edits held for moderation, have no passing assertion in this clause's evidence; the held submission and comment are asserted.

status_rows.title: Voting
status_rows.gap: Refusing a vote outside Open, Under review, Planned or In progress, and the author's vote recorded at submission counting once, have no passing assertion; one vote per identity and the distinct-voter total are asserted.

status_rows.title: Merge
status_rows.gap: Moving the duplicate's evidence links, approved attachments and followers, keeping its title and source as merge history, and merging a duplicate into the end of its chain have no passing assertion; the 301, moved comments and collapsed votes are asserted.

status_rows.title: Unmerge
status_rows.gap: Restoring the duplicate's votes, followers and evidence links, leaving post-merge additions on the canonical request and recording the reversal have no passing assertion; the duplicate's comment and status update reappearing are asserted.

status_rows.title: Follow and consent
status_rows.gap: The unticked "Email me updates" control on submit and vote, the vote-subscription wording and its follow, the author's subscription, and the timestamped permission record from a follow or a tick have no passing assertion.

status_rows.title: Portal attachments
status_rows.gap: Rejecting a file with a reason without rejecting the request, and the declared content type and inline disposition of a published image, have no passing assertion; approval, the 404 before it and the served bytes are asserted.

status_rows.title: Portal search and browse
status_rows.gap: Category filtering, newest and recency-weighted last-14-day trending are implemented alongside search, board, status and existing sorts. Gap: the 500 ms first page has no seeded run at the `seed.json` limits (D-3).

status_rows.title: Submission idempotency
status_rows.gap: No test repeats a submission with its idempotency key to get the original request and evidence result back, sends a changed body under the same key for 409, or checks 30-day key retention and keys holding no personal data.

status_rows.title: Identity failure
status_rows.gap: The visitor being offered email verification (REQ-023) after a rejected identity has no passing assertion; the refusal of expired, future-dated and wrongly signed claims at the host-identity exchange with the identity-required error, no writes and no account or identity disclosure is asserted.

status_rows.title: Status updates
status_rows.gap: A status update rendered distinctly from comments, pinned above them and notifying followers under NOTIFY-001 has no passing assertion; posting a pinned update and its text on the request are asserted.

status_rows.title: Decline
status_rows.evidence: `tests/base/request-status-workflow.test.ts` — sets a direct plan and ETA, resolves latest changes, configures private statuses and projects only eligible roadmap cards (reason refusal, declined history, closed participation, direct and mapped reversal); `tests/browser/request-decline.mjs` — request-decline (operator controls and customer history, repeated decline and reversal, screens at 1440 and 390)

status_rows.title: Boards
status_rows.gap: Renaming, reordering and archiving boards, moving a request with its votes, comments, followers and evidence links, and the 409 on submission to an archived board have no passing assertion.

status_rows.title: Internal boards
status_rows.gap: Keeping internal-board requests off the public roadmap, out of releases and out of requester notifications has no passing assertion in this clause's evidence; the request and attachment 404s are asserted.

status_rows.title: Requester's own content
status_rows.gap: Gap: Own-comment editing, retention of approved public text during review, and auto-publish edit/history lack passing assertions.

status_rows.title: Email verification
status_rows.gap: The verified session expiring after 30 days without use, and a held action discarded after 24 hours without verification, have no passing assertion; held actions applied on verification are asserted.

status_rows.title: Requester identity merge
status_rows.gap: The survivor keeping both verified addresses and all requests, comments, follows and permission records, votes collapsing to one, the recorded merge, and no new vote or permission record have no passing assertion; carried mutes and preferences and working old links are asserted.

status_rows.title: Requester activity
status_rows.gap: The current moderation state and public status of the requester's own requests in the view have no passing assertion; the view's counts of their requests, votes, follows and comments including held and rejected ones, and unfollow, mute and subscription changes from it, are asserted.

status_rows.title: Demand attribution
status_rows.gap: The vote date in the private supporter view, and the first 50 supporters on expansion with Show more revealing 50 more at a time, have no passing assertion (the browser check clicks Show more until it is gone and counts only the full history); the separate vote, linked-evidence and distinct-account figures with no score, the supporter view's names, addresses, accounts, proxy marks and per-account totals, the complete history with no 100-person cap, and the portal showing none of it are asserted.

status_rows.title: Request queue
status_rows.gap: Queue filters and sorts work; the 500 ms first page has no seeded run at the `seed.json` limits (D-3).

status_rows.title: Moderation verdicts
status_rows.gap: A rejected item counting toward no public total and staying visible with its reason to its author and operators, and the author notice's consent, suppression, mute and quiet-hours checks, have no passing assertion; the unsubscribe link and the once-only send are asserted.

status_rows.title: Internal notes
status_rows.evidence: `tests/browser/internal-discussion.mjs` — native note and public comment controls on one approved request, distinct labelled rendering and unchanged identities after reload; `tests/base/penny-evidence.test.ts` — "[AI-009 AI-006 EVID-006] answers and drafts resolve citations, enforce cost and role privacy, and send only to the chosen destination while keeping private records out of publication and requester mail" checks portal responses, complete page metadata, releases and requester notifications.

status_rows.title: States and queue
status_rows.gap: The review date in the decision queue has no passing assertion; decisions in every state staying in the queue with their state and owner, and the last action and linked-evidence count, are asserted.

status_rows.title: Brief
status_rows.gap: Per-bet assumptions, the low, medium or high confidence level, the review date, and the requesters currently eligible under REL-004 through the mapped requests have no passing assertion, and the brief does not carry the eligible requesters yet; the question, accountable owner, candidate bets, linked evidence and accounts, and each bet's counter-evidence count are asserted.

status_rows.title: Comparable bets
status_rows.gap: The absence of a stored or displayed combined score and of an automatic ranking has no passing assertion: the bet record and the stored snapshot are checked in a way that allows extra fields, and bets are looked up by id, so their order is unchecked; each bet's metrics holding exactly the five dimension figures is asserted.

status_rows.title: Commitment
status_rows.gap: The `decision.commitment.v1` default that any operator may commit has no passing assertion, since every cited commit runs as the owner; the recorded declined bets and the evidence snapshot of evidence IDs, evidence-version IDs and DEC-003 dimensions, with the evidence itself unchanged, are asserted.

status_rows.title: Internal states
status_rows.gap: The activity entry a status change adds to the linked decision has no passing assertion in this clause's evidence; each transition's actor, reason and from and to status, the decision's unchanged state, and backward moves recorded as further transitions are asserted.

status_rows.title: Public projection
status_rows.gap: The absence of account names, revenue, internal dates, confidence, rationale, evidence, declined bets and delivery notes from the projection has no passing assertion in this clause's evidence, whose check of the public item allows extra fields; the projected public status within 5 seconds and a dropped item's withdrawal are asserted.

status_rows.title: Status update draft
status_rows.gap: The draft's absence of internal rationale, commercial context, declined bets and outcome prompts has no passing assertion in this clause's evidence, whose check of the draft allows extra fields, and no cited case reads the portal before the draft is published; a draft prepared for each approved status change with the safe title, problem and new public status, unpublished until an operator publishes it, and no draft for an unapproved item are asserted.

status_rows.title: Draft and targets
status_rows.gap: A saved draft holding its publication date, optional setup or usage link and outcome-prompt wording has no passing assertion; the title, type, tag, body, author and target are entered and saved.

status_rows.title: Recipient eligibility and snapshot
status_rows.gap: The snapshot staying unchanged after a later merge, relink or preference change, and the `release.recipient-eligibility.v1` default (which actions grant a permission record, that voting elsewhere and an operator-entered address grant none, and NOTIFY-009's one-snapshot addition) have no passing assertion; export and restore of the snapshot tables, an identity merge fenced while a send is in flight, and follower erasure are asserted.

status_rows.title: Customer-safe delivery
status_rows.gap: The owner's brand header (INT-008), sender identity (NOTIFY-013) and postal address (NOTIFY-014) in release email have no passing assertion in this clause's evidence; private context staying out of the public updates is asserted.

status_rows.title: Acceptance and retry
status_rows.gap: The published update staying visible on the portal in every failure state has no passing assertion, and an ambiguous or interrupted send held unknown with no replay (point 3, reconciled with RL-3) is asserted for requester status-update mail but not for a release delivery; bounded retry of known failures ending in failed, and a restored queued release held unknown and inert, are asserted.

status_rows.title: Idempotent delivery and provider events
status_rows.gap: Resend idempotency key and signed event dedupe ship; SendGrid has no provider duplicate suppression, so its delivery key is correlation only (RL-3).

status_rows.title: Bounces and complaints
status_rows.gap: A soft bounce marking one delivery failed and suppressing nothing, a spam complaint's suppression, and suppression removing no vote, request, comment or portal access have no passing assertion; hard-bounce suppression is asserted.

status_rows.title: Delivery states
status_rows.gap: An out-of-order provider event never moving a delivery backward and never counting a result twice has no passing assertion.

status_rows.title: Requester updates
status_rows.gap: Notifying voters on vote-subscription boards (NOTIFY-008) as followers has no passing assertion; the subscribed author's notice is asserted.

status_rows.title: No mail loops
status_rows.gap: Sign-in and verification mail going out from `MAIL_FROM` or a NOTIFY-013 sender, with `Auto-Submitted: auto-generated` and no reply-to, has no passing assertion; a follower's status notification's sender, header and absent reply-to, and the refusal of its reply at every door, are asserted.

status_rows.title: Notification failure
status_rows.evidence: `tests/base/notifications.test.ts`; `tests/base/penny-decisions.test.ts` — "completing a review holds that schedule; reminders stay in app until dismissed even when mail fails" reads the same due decision, review date and notification identity through authenticated operator routes in each failure state and after later drains. Both retain bounded retries, visible failure and unknown-send no-replay assertions.

status_rows.title: Public/private boundary
status_rows.gap: The absence of operator-only field names and values from a public payload has no passing assertion over a non-empty response: both cited checks read the public request list while it holds no published request (the non-empty public-surface scan in `tests/base/penny-evidence.test.ts` is not cited here); the refusal of invalid signed claims without writes or identity disclosure is asserted.

status_rows.title: Permitted originals
status_rows.gap: The deployment pinning the source installation and permitted source principals, and model output being unable to set identity or grants, have no passing assertion; separate original text, revision and time fields and nullable source identity are asserted.

status_rows.title: Contestable learning
status_rows.gap: Every option carrying the DEC-003 dimensions computed from originals, invalidation by native or source corrections with versioned operator contests, and the absence of automatic ranking, customer contact or publication have no passing assertion in this clause's evidence; validated spans, the clarification and the no-build option are asserted.

status_rows.title: Accountable pre-action choice
status_rows.gap: The committed snapshot retaining the interpretation, original evidence, compared options, owner and full predeclared protocol, and missing protocol fields as explicit nulls that prevent commitment, have no passing assertion in this clause's evidence; commitment and its attributed audit are asserted.

status_rows.title: Bounded recurring work
status_rows.gap: Expiry, budget, correction-version and erasure-epoch checks before external work and in the result transaction, the absence of any implicit contact, production or publication effect, and interrupted or ambiguous calls keeping their uncertainty and reserved budget without retry have no passing assertion in this clause's evidence; durable runs, unchanged-input deduplication, in-flight pause and revoke, and pause, resume, revoke and disconnect are asserted.

status_rows.title: Privacy closure
status_rows.evidence: Points 1–2 and archive history: `tests/base/learning-stage3.test.ts` — "source person erasure covers duplicate connections and fresh-grant replay; actual restore holds all source authority". Point 3: the same file — "observed provider credential revocation purges all matching source installations; outage preserves evidence" and "scheduled refresh obtains new evidence, deduplicates unchanged work and supports pause, correction, resume and revoke" (scope and erasure fences). Point 4: the source-person journey calls `tests/base/learning-running-restore.ts` — proveRunningRestore, authenticating export, fresh-destination import and detail readback of the uncertain claim, retained cursor and unresolved cost, held authority and refused replay.

status_rows.title: Owner editor
status_rows.gap: Compiled data-only edits applying after the destination hydrates with native navigation and privacy preserved, and the management service's own admission of its owner and frame origin, have no passing assertion; the short owner-only lease and the refusal of other operators and foreign origins are asserted.

status_rows.title: Scoped keys
status_rows.evidence: `tests/base/proxy-votes.test.ts` — server-held scoped keys record proxy demand, refuse a read-only key and stop on revocation (points 1–3); `tests/base/integration-api.test.ts` — issues a reveal-once hashed key, confines route-selected scopes to the REST namespace and refuses unissued keys without a usage record; expiry, revocation, issuer removal and usage-write failure refuse authority after a fresh runtime

status_rows.title: Current custody
status_rows.gap: Credentials staying out of portable archives, and a restore honouring none, have no passing assertion; usage metadata written before authority is returned with storage failure refusing, revocation, expiry and issuer removal fencing requests and business writes, and a bearer key refused at export are asserted.

status_rows.title: Native publication
status_rows.gap: That imported or restored history creates no new publication or integration effect has no passing assertion: the cited upgrade case snapshots its tables after the import and compares them only across migrations, and no cited case restores an archive; prior history, including imported feedback, staying unchanged across each new migration is asserted.

status_rows.title: Explicit integration effects
status_rows.gap: Gap: Selected public event kinds, immutable destinations, atomic business-write/event-target capture, held restored history and portable safe integration history with nonportable credentials lack complete passing assertions.

status_rows.title: Durable uncertainty
status_rows.gap: Gap: Durable attempt identity, finite retry, ambiguity/reconciliation and revoked/private/blocked send fencing lack complete passing assertions.

status_rows.title: Deliberate tracker issues
status_rows.gap: Gap: Complete Linear/Jira create and link from requests/decisions, entered-only wording and uncertain-outcome reconciliation lack passing assertions.

status_rows.title: Owner portal branding
status_rows.gap: The accent, description and Penny mark controls ship. Uploaded logos and favicons, their same-origin versioned serving and upload refusals, the website link and theme selection remain unproved.

status_rows.title: Brand on every customer surface
status_rows.gap: The company name is collected at setup and used by sender identity (OPS-005, NOTIFY-013); applying it throughout the portal in place of `publicLandingConfig.ownerName`, the website link, the logo on the widget, the changelog, the sign-in page and email, and the neutral default icon remain unproved.

status_rows.title: Branding permissions and portability
status_rows.gap: Admin branding controls remain unproved: the 403 refusals of branding writes by other roles and the archive round trip of logo bytes and branding settings have no passing assertion.

status_rows.title: Workspace timezone and requester quiet hours
Custom roles and restricted commercial fields
status_rows.gap: A base test signs in under a role without commercial permission and reads requests, accounts, prioritization views, CSV exports and Ask Penny answers through their routes: no revenue, opportunity or health value appears; granting the permission reveals them on the next request; each role change is in the audit log (ROLE-004).

status_rows.title: Operator single sign-on
status_rows.gap: Today only the optional `IDENTITY_PROVIDER` dependency is declared; sign-in remains email links. A browser journey against SAML and OIDC test identity providers at the network edge: a first sign-in creates a Contributor, a group claim maps another user to Admin, an enforced domain refuses an email link, and an IdP-side deactivation ends access at the next session check.

status_rows.title: SCIM provisioning
status_rows.gap: Okta and Entra SCIM request fixtures through the public endpoint create, patch and deactivate a user; the deactivated user's session and API key are refused on their next request, as they are after OPS-002 removal.

status_rows.title: Audit log
status_rows.gap: Durable actor audits are recorded and archived today; there is no audit screen or export. Perform each listed action (including REQ-038 and REQ-041 edits, removals, restores and permanent deletes and INT-007 and NOTIFY-013 changes), then read and export the log through the UI and API; erase an operator and see their entries anonymized while the events remain.

status_rows.title: Saved views and filters
status_rows.gap: A browser test saves a filtered, sorted view, then a second operator opens the shared view and gets the same result set; a private view is not listed for them.

status_rows.title: Person view
status_rows.gap: Voter lists and account requesters ship today; no per-person page exists. A fixture requester with two posts, three votes, a comment, captured Zendesk evidence and an account: the profile lists each with a link to its record; a role without commercial permission sees no ARR or MRR; the profile path answers 404 to a portal visitor and appears in no public payload.

status_rows.title: Feedback inbox
status_rows.gap: Today the unreviewed evidence list does this for portal and manually recorded evidence only. A browser journey at 1440 and 390 pixels: items from three connector fixtures arrive, are triaged by keyboard (link, create, dismiss with reason, snooze), each linked request shows the item with its source link, and the overview counts match the inbox.

status_rows.title: Source provenance and link-back
status_rows.gap: EVID-002 provenance ships today for manually recorded sources without deep links or source sync. A connector fixture test captures a record, edits it at the source and deletes it at the source: Penny shows changed and removed states, purges the excerpt at the window, and the deep link opens the original record.

status_rows.title: Zendesk
status_rows.gap: Zendesk OAuth, API and webhook fixtures at the network edge: install, link, create and proxy-vote from the sidebar; tag-triggered capture creates one item per ticket however often the webhook replays; the status appears in the sidebar; uninstalling revokes and deletes the tokens.

status_rows.title: Intercom
status_rows.gap: Intercom API and webhook fixtures run CAP-003's journey and show company attributes arriving as private segment attributes.

status_rows.title: HappyToHelp
status_rows.gap: A journey against a running HappyToHelp test installation links a ticket, captures one by tag and receives the drafted status reply on that ticket.

status_rows.title: Help Scout
status_rows.gap: Help Scout API fixtures: link, create, tag capture and mapping, each once per conversation.

status_rows.title: Gong
status_rows.gap: Gong API fixtures: filtered calls are ingested, proposals carry exact transcript spans and timestamps, accounts map through Gong's CRM association, and the fixture records no request for an out-of-filter call.

status_rows.title: Call recorders, recordings and transcripts
status_rows.gap: Fathom, Zoom, Google Meet, Fireflies, Grain and tl;dv fixtures each ingest one filtered call with timestamped spans and ignore an out-of-filter call; a VTT upload produces a searchable transcript whose highlight becomes evidence with a timestamp link; an audio upload shows progress, reserved and metered cost, and a visible failure when the provider fails.

status_rows.title: Slack and Nook
status_rows.gap: Signed Slack Events and Interactivity fixtures: the shortcut and the reaction each capture a message once, a bad signature is refused, and a Slack Connect channel maps to its account; the same capture runs against a Nook test installation.

status_rows.title: Microsoft Teams
status_rows.gap: Bot Framework fixtures with token validation capture a message once and refuse an unsigned request.

status_rows.title: Browser extension
status_rows.gap: A Playwright extension journey on a fixture page creates an inbox item with the URL, excerpt and screenshot attachment; a signed-out extension is refused.

status_rows.title: CRM record panels
status_rows.gap: HubSpot and Salesforce fixtures render the panel for a record's company, capture feedback tied to an opportunity amount and attribute a proxy vote to the right customer.

status_rows.title: Proxy votes
status_rows.gap: UserVoice-imported supporters keeping their historical proxy marks (IMP-008) have no passing assertion in this clause's evidence (`tests/base/feedback-import-uservoice.test.ts` asserts them and is not cited here), and the CSV export is checked for the source text and the customer but never the recorder; counting once per customer, the proxy mark with who recorded it, collapse with the customer's own later vote, no verified identity, consent or permission record, public appearance only inside the vote total, and recording from the inbox, the request page and the Zendesk sidebar fixture are asserted.

status_rows.title: Automation platforms
status_rows.gap: Scoped keys and outbound events ship today; no packaged app exists. A Zapier CLI test against a running installation fires each trigger once per event and runs each action within its key's scopes; an out-of-scope action is refused.

status_rows.title: Connector health
status_rows.gap: Delivery and tracker-receipt states are shown today for outbound integrations only. A clock-advanced fixture with an expired token and a rate limit shows the connector failing with its reason once an hour passes without a successful sync (or after the owner's shorter setting), notifies the owner once, and after reconnect resumes from its cursor without duplicate items.

status_rows.title: Capture scope, minimization and consent
status_rows.gap: Purpose-bound selected-record acquisition ships today for Orbit and native records (LEARN-001). Connector fixtures assert that no request is made for out-of-scope records, that redaction precedes the write, and that captured people hold no permission record (NOTIFY-009 sends create none either).

status_rows.title: Submission forms and polls
status_rows.gap: A conditional question renders and validates on the portal and the widget at both widths; poll answers aggregate per request and by segment and stay operator-only.

status_rows.title: Freshdesk
status_rows.gap: Freshdesk API and webhook fixtures run CAP-003's journey: install, link, create and proxy-vote from the sidebar; tag-triggered capture creates one item per ticket however often the webhook replays; company fields arrive as private attributes; a shipped request drafts one reply on the linked ticket; uninstalling revokes and deletes the API key.

status_rows.title: Review sites and app stores
status_rows.gap: Recorded fixtures from G2, Capterra, TrustRadius, Trustpilot, Product Hunt, the App Store and Google Play produce one inbox item per review however often the feed is re-read, each with its rating, date and a deep link that opens that review; an edited fixture review shows changed;

status_rows.title: Discord
status_rows.gap: Signed interaction and gateway fixtures: the command and the reaction each capture a message once with its jump link, a bad signature is refused, and a message in an unselected channel is never read.

status_rows.title: Survey responses
status_rows.gap: Typeform, SurveyMonkey, Google Forms and Pencil fixtures produce one inbox item per response with its link and mapped attributes; a replayed webhook creates nothing; a bad Typeform signature is refused; an unmapped question's answer is absent from D1 and the archive.

status_rows.title: In-app feedback widget
status_rows.gap: Allow-listed iframe embedding of the portal (REQ-027) ships today. A browser test on a fixture host page at both widths: an identified user submits, votes and follows, and on an auto-publish board sees their post listed at once; the page URL appears only in private evidence; the documented CSP directives suffice; no third-party cookie is set.

status_rows.title: SSO identify
status_rows.gap: REQ-031 host identity ships for the portal today, by `postMessage` from an allow-listed parent frame only. Host-identity tests extended to JWT and to the widget origin: a valid token identifies the user and links the account with private attributes; expired, future-dated and forged tokens are refused and change nothing.

status_rows.title: Changelog widget and announcements
status_rows.gap: A browser test: the unread count falls after viewing; a segment-targeted announcement shows only to matching identified users; an unpublished release never appears.

status_rows.title: Mobile SDKs
status_rows.gap: SDK sample apps run XCTest and Espresso UI tests against a test installation: identified submit, vote and changelog read, and a queued offline submission sent once on reconnect.

status_rows.title: Moment capture
status_rows.gap: A fixture host triggers two moments; their answers arrive as evidence tagged with the moment; the widget sends nothing to Penny until a call is made.

status_rows.title: Portal domain and audiences
status_rows.gap: A browser test: a segment member sees the restricted board while a non-member and a signed-out visitor get 404 and no count; on an SSO-required portal, a signed-out request to a request page, the board, the public API, the feed and an attachment returns no request content (WIDGET-008's redirect or the sign-in page for documents, 401 for the rest), and REQ-023's link and REQ-039's buttons are absent; a custom hostname configured through the deployment path serves the portal (its TLS receipt is R-7).

status_rows.title: Localized portal and widget
status_rows.gap: A browser test renders the portal and widget in Spanish once through Accept-Language and once through an identify locale, with no English interface string left; a catalog missing a key fails the build; a status email to a requester identified with `es` arrives in Spanish.

status_rows.title: SSO sign-in redirect
status_rows.gap: Today host identity reaches the portal only by `postMessage` from an allow-listed parent frame (`src/core/features/auth/ui/host-identity-bridge.tsx`); there is no login URL, redirect or state. At both widths against a fixture host: a signed-out visitor to `/portal/feedback/<request>` on an SSO-required portal is redirected to the login URL; with SSO required and no token the request page response carries no request content.

status_rows.title: SSO return and refusals
status_rows.gap: There is no login URL, callback or state today. At both widths against a fixture host: the visitor returns with a valid token and lands on the request identified, with no cookie and no token left in the address bar; a vote chosen before sign-in is applied once after return; an expired token, a forged token, a reused state, a tampered return path and a return path on another origin are each refused and change nothing.

status_rows.title: Links from email into the owner's product
status_rows.gap: There is no in-app link pattern today. With Open requests in my product on, a status email's request link follows the owner's pattern and the fixture host's widget opens that request; the unsubscribe link works signed out.

status_rows.title: Semantic duplicate detection
status_rows.gap: The `duplicates-v1` evaluation meets the AI-001 bars (precision ≥ 0.90, recall ≥ 0.85, top-five ≥ 0.90, paraphrase recall ≥ lexical + 0.15); requester suggestions contain only published requests; with the model disabled, lexical suggestions still return within EVID-007's limit.

status_rows.title: Auto-link suggestions
status_rows.gap: The `links-v1` evaluation meets the AI-002 bars; an inbox journey accepts and rejects suggestions; an auto-link rule on one fixture source links only above its threshold, marks and can undo each link, and changes no public payload.

status_rows.title: Duplicate sweep and merge proposals
status_rows.gap: Reversible explicit merge (REQ-008, REQ-009) ships today. The `merges-v1` evaluation with its 0.80 coverage and 0.85 precision sweep bar and zero wrongful automatic merges on the labelled fixture, the sweep and its proposals, and the evaluation-gated, off-by-default, one-board auto-merge rule that logs each merge for REQ-009 to restore are not built.

status_rows.title: Request extraction from conversations
status_rows.gap: Selected Orbit and native evidence produce cited learning options today, not requests.
